data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, 'Zahraat' is also the name given to Fatima Zahra (as), the daughter of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and his wife Ayesha (ra). She is considered a eternal paradise, guiding light and role model for all Muslims. Zahra's name is closely associated with the virtues of love, kindness, and respect towards the Prophet and his family (Ahlul Bayt), and serves as an inspiration for Muslims to strive towards inner and outer beauty in their lives.

historical_references.context: Zahra bint Ali, also known as Fatimah bint Hassan, was an influential figure during the early Islamic period. She was the granddaughter of the Prophet Muhammad and the daughter of Imam Ali and Fatimah bint Muhammad. Zahra, whose name means 'flower' or 'radiant', was renowned for her exceptional piety and wisdom. She was a source of guidance and support for her father, and her home in Medina became a center for scholars and pious individuals.
